item.title: How to Give Claude Code a Real Browser: Headful Chromium in Docker with Playwright MCP
item.description: Run a headful Chromium in Docker on your dev VM so Claude Code can browse, shop and screenshot sites with no laptop on, and watch it over VNC from a phone.

item.description: Develop Python scripts inside Docker containers for reproducible, isolated environments, and how that compares with virtual environments for team tooling.

item.description: Deploy PostgreSQL with Docker Compose and an init script that creates databases and users automatically. Portable, isolated Postgres with Compose V2 and Bash.

item.title: Wyoming Piper Docker Compose: Local Text-to-Speech for Home Assistant
item.description: Run Wyoming Piper text-to-speech in Docker Compose for Home Assistant. Tested compose file, voice naming, 174 voices and corrections to my 2023 post.

item.title: Wyoming Whisper Docker Compose: Local Speech-to-Text for Home Assistant
item.description: Run Wyoming Whisper speech-to-text in Docker Compose for Home Assistant. Tested compose file, model speeds measured on a Ryzen 5 5600 and a test script.

item.title: Running Uptime Kuma With Docker Compose

item.description: Run Honeygain in Docker with Compose. Tested compose file that keeps your login out of the YAML, the real CLI flags, and what docker inspect still shows.
